integrity: The existence and extremality theorem itself is prior work. The new claim is the exact branch identity \(s_2=\kappa=(a-1)^2\) and the uniform analytic certificate \(9\kappa\gamma<27/43\). Finite verification is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the two-state hard-core model on the order-three Cayley tree and to its nontranslation-invariant two-periodic branch. The constant \(27/43\) is the sharp supremum of the displayed sufficient-certificate bound, not an optimal general reconstruction threshold.
title: Exact reconstruction margin on the order-three hard-core periodic branch
